item.title: Cyprus arrests Lebanese man wanted by Germany on terrorism charges, at Larnaca airport
item.description: Police arrested a 25-year-old Lebanese man at Larnaca airport on Friday evening after he was found to be subject to a Red Notice and wanted by German authorities for terrorism-related offences. item.title: Turkey might send fighter planes to occupied north Cyprus, source tells Reuters
item.description: Turkey is considering the deployment of F-16 aircraft to Cyprus, a Turkish defence ministry source told Reuters on Saturday.
